scope.dataset_bank: exact same 360 confirmatory simulation datasets used by frozen 05e context

data_adapter.standardization: Within each actual fit/training split, estimate feature center and scale from observed entries in that fit split only; apply those parameters to held-out rows. For a full-data scientific fit, the full dataset is the fit split.

iCluster2b.fit_rule: One prospectively seeded tune.iCluster2b call per dataset; use the returned lambda values for the scientific K=5 fit. No performance/truth/outcome-guided retuning.
iCluster2b.stability_reason: 05cmp1 froze one deterministic iCluster2b scientific seed and did not freeze a resampling/replicate schedule for this method. 05cmp2 will not invent one after 05e.

architecture_selection_stage_1.fold_assignment: Sort the frozen sample IDs lexicographically within each dataset and assign fold = sorted_position mod 5. No truth or outcome enters the assignment.
architecture_selection_stage_1.metric: mean held-out reconstruction SSE over observed standardized entries only
architecture_selection_stage_1.rule: retain candidates within one standard error of the best mean reconstruction SSE

architecture_selection_stage_2.pairwise_subspace_metric: For each seed pair, center latent coordinates, obtain orthonormal column-space bases by thin SVD, compute the five singular values of Q_A^T Q_B, take their arithmetic mean; candidate stability is the median of the three pairwise means.
architecture_selection_stage_2.selection: highest stability; exact ties -> fewer hidden parameters -> lexical candidate_id
architecture_selection_stage_2.other_seed_role: stability diagnostic only; never replace canonical_fit

metric_semantics.shared_subspace_recovery: Use the existing Paper 5 simulation definition: mean canonical correlation between estimated and true shared latent subspaces; truth is accessed only after the representation fit is complete.
metric_semantics.factor_alignment_correlation: Sign/permutation-invariant factor alignment on the frozen simulation truth; runner must reuse the same Paper 5 alignment semantics/helpers already used in the simulation branch rather than define a new post-hoc metric.
metric_semantics.scenario_robustness_summary: Aggregate only over the same 36 frozen scenario groups; report method/scenario summaries and an overall scenario-balanced descriptive summary. No winner threshold.
metric_semantics.missing_view_robustness: Use only the already-frozen missing-view scenarios and the fixed zero adapter. No comparator-specific rescue.
metric_semantics.heldout_reconstruction: MOVE-native descriptive endpoint only; do not compare directly against iCluster2b because 05cmp1 marked it ineligible there.

failure_policy.per_dataset_fit_failure: Retry once with identical configuration and identical seed. If it fails again, keep the dataset-method failure in the denominator/manifest.
